sentences.text:
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement  (Virtual /Physical Mode).
2.
This interlocutory application has been filed by the Petitioner for amendment of the cause title of the petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. as per the schedule of amendment sought.

3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that prosecution report under Annexure-1 reveals that in Case No.03 dated 29.10.2007, which has been registered under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, the State-Opposite Party has narrated as a party represented by one Sri Satyajit Patel, I/c. Food Inspector, Subarnapur.

He further submitted that while filing petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. inadvertently the Petitioner has arrayed the Food Inspector, Subarnapur by his name as Opposite Party and the // 2 // original accused as Opposite Party No.2.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner further contended that the Petitioner-Company was subsequently added as an accused in the 2(C)CC No.5 of 2007, out of which, the petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. arises.
4.
Considering such submission, the prayer for amendment is allowed.
5. Consolidated cause title of the Criminal Misc. Case be filed within a week hence.
